items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And then we could get, from time to time, Alphonso Trent (phonetic) coming from that hotel in Dallas

ctx.x: Well, one thing I was going to say to you: I take it in those days that Earl and Chicago, because of radio, was probably a fairly big influence in Kansas City, wasn't it?
Well, don't forget now, Earl was the influence on us in Texas.
